language_task: Place the toys on the plate with no collisions.
outcome_evidence: The beige, pink, and blue toys initially lie beside the empty plate (frame 0, overhead_cam and wrist_cam). The robot sequentially grasps and releases the beige toy onto the plate (frames 130–145), the pink toy (frames 294–304), and the blue toy (frames 493–506), visible in overhead_cam and wrist_cam. All three remain on the plate after the gripper withdraws and through frame 744 in both cameras. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or unintended side effect is visibly established; the final stationary period occurs after task completion.
